content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Contact Us ## slug: events-contact-us ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Allow your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to contact you with any questions about your {{variable.Object_Event}}! ## Overview The Contact Us feature allows Event Organizers to easily receive questions and comments from the {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. To reduce spam emails and deter automated submissions sent via the Contact Us feature, a reCAPTCHA challenge was added to the Contact Us form. If there are reCAPTCHA loading issues while using a vanity domain or subdomain, please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to have your domain allowlisted. ## Instructions 1. Add the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field to your {{variable.Object_Event}} page layout and enter the email address that should receive all the responses. ![Add Contact Us Email to Event page layout](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Add%20Contact%20Us%20Email%20to%20Event%20page%20layout.png){height="" width=""} 2. The {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_ContactUs}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record needs to be set to {{variable.picklist_Always}}. ![Contact Us tab Setting Always](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Contact%20Us%20tab%20Setting%20Always.png){height="" width=""} Now you are ready to accept questions and comments. ![accept questions and comments](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/accept%20questions%20and%20comments.png){height="" width=""} Responses will show up in your email and look like this: ![responses](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/responses.png){height="" width=""} ## FAQs **Q: Are questions asked by registrants via the Contact Us Form on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page saved as records in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}?** A: No, Blackthorn does not save questions asked by registrants during {{variable.Object_Event}} registration as {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} records. **Q: How do I respond to my Attendee?** A: To respond to your Attendee, click on the email within the message. This will pop open a new message where you can reply back. Clicking the **Reply All** button will send your message back to Blackthorn Support.
